confirmatory.holm_note: Confirmatory family contains the pre-specified Resist FCR test only at one-sided alpha=0.05. Use paired movement is structurally unsuitable for confirmation because controls are correct by design, so treating Use as pre-specified estimation contributes no Type-I mass and does not inflate FWER. The conservative two-test Holm FCR-at-0.025 sensitivity is reported alongside.
